decisions.reason: The source changes help-text persistence after a field is emptied, not the language or content of field labels and placeholders.
The requirement that help text remain available does not alter when or how placeholder text clears upon field activation.
Persistent help text can coexist with editable or deletable field content and does not necessarily change the selected field implementation architecture.
Help-text persistence does not change the requirement to preserve Title-field formatting during interaction.
The source does not resolve or modify the separate requirement concerning grey editable-field cues.
The calendar-dropdown date-entry mechanism is unaffected by the persistence of help text after field content is emptied.
The source does not change the checklist and dropdown control configuration.
The overlap concerns generic content and text terminology; help-text persistence does not affect legacy-content paste stability.
Field help text is distinct from image and table caption labels, so the caption targets, typography, and style name remain unchanged.
Help-text persistence has no necessary effect on pasted table structure or column containment.
The source does not modify manual line-break behavior after legacy-content pasting.
The persistence of help text in interactive fields does not change the required theme-color palette.
